ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity contrast ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity (white) surface area punctuated by low-intensity (black) pigmentation at the trailing edges, tips, and focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge boundary and distal tips; extensive distribution of discrete, roughly circular dark-pixel blobs and annular rings across the interior white field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 65-75 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending approximately 18% into the vertical fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; numerous small peaks and valleys (2-10 pixels in amplitude) along the continuous linear boundary between the fluke and the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a distinct concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges (partially submerged) show a convex sweep toward the water surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular, high-contrast dark pixel clusters with light-intensity centers, distributed densely across the medial and lateral surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions observed on the lower-left lobe and medial-right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular chipping and small secondary notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive circular scarring patterns across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular focal point located in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
